text_block_list.text: I trained thoroughly too, so I should be able to win this time...!

text_block_list.text:

choice_data_list: Don't forget to stay calm, either.
Don't forget to take a breather, okay?

text_block_list.text:
I love taking detours, but races are a different story!
I'm aiming only for 1st place—here I go!
